## Next batch

- HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0012 · AVOID — Avoid making a dynamic menu item the only way to accomplish a task · The menu bar > Dynamic menu items ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/the-menu-bar))
- HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0018 · AVOID — Avoid relying on the presence of menu bar extras · The menu bar > Platform considerations > macOS > Menu bar extras ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/the-menu-bar))
- HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0001 · SHOULD — Support the default system-defined menus and their ordering · The menu bar > Best practices ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/the-menu-bar))
- HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0003 · SHOULD — Support the keyboard shortcuts defined for the standard menu items you include · The menu bar > Best practices ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/the-menu-bar))
- HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0004 · SHOULD — Prefer short, one-word menu titles · The menu bar > Best practices ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/the-menu-bar))
- HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0005 · SHOULD — Display the About menu item first · The menu bar > App menu ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/the-menu-bar))
- HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0006 · SHOULD — Provide a View menu even if your app supports only a subset of the standard view functions · The menu bar > View menu ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/the-menu-bar))
- HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0008 · SHOULD — Provide app-specific menus for custom commands · The menu bar > App-specific menus ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/the-menu-bar))
- HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0009 · SHOULD — Aim to list app-specific menus in order from most to least general or commonly used · The menu bar > App-specific menus ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/the-menu-bar))
- HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0010 · SHOULD — Provide a Window menu even if your app has only one window · The menu bar > Window menu ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/the-menu-bar))
- HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0013 · SHOULD — Use dynamic menu items primarily in menu bar menus · The menu bar > Dynamic menu items ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/the-menu-bar))
- HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0016 · SHOULD — Display a menu — not a popover — when people click your menu bar extra · The menu bar > Platform considerations > macOS > Menu bar extras ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/the-menu-bar))
- HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0017 · SHOULD — Let people — not your app — decide whether to put your menu bar extra in the menu bar · The menu bar > Platform considerations > macOS > Menu bar extras ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/the-menu-bar))
- HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0011 · MAY — Consider including menu items for showing and hiding panels · The menu bar > Window menu ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/the-menu-bar))
- HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0014 · MAY — Consider grouping menu items into submenus to conserve vertical space · The menu bar > Platform considerations > iPadOS ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/the-menu-bar))
- HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0015 · MAY — Consider using a symbol to represent your menu bar extra · The menu bar > Platform considerations > macOS > Menu bar extras ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/the-menu-bar))
- HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0019 · MAY — Consider exposing app-specific functionality in other ways, too · The menu bar > Platform considerations > macOS > Menu bar extras ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/the-menu-bar))
